items.title: Financial Services Chatbots
items.description: Chicago's financial sector — CME Group, derivatives firms, banks, and insurance companies — has specific chatbot requirements shaped by FINRA content standards, MiFID II/CFTC communication obligations, and the need for licensed representative escalation on regulated topics. Client-facing financial assistants: answering account questions, product information, and service requests with appropriate disclosures and escalation routing to licensed representatives for advice-requiring inquiries. Internal compliance Q&A: RAG-powered assistants over internal policy documents, regulatory guidance, and compliance training materials. Trader support assistants: internal knowledge systems answering questions about trading systems, risk parameters, and operational procedures without client communication. All Chicago financial chatbots include FINRA/CFTC-compliant conversation logging, mandatory disclosure insertion for regulated topics, and licensed representative escalation workflows. Cost: $25,000–$75,000 | Timeline: 10–18 weeks.

sections.title: Chicago Chatbot Compliance Requirements
sections.description: Chicago's regulated industries have specific compliance requirements that ClickMasters builds into chatbot design from the start.

items.title: Financial Services (FINRA Rule 2210 / CFTC)
items.description: Communications with customers about securities or futures must meet content standards — AI chatbots cannot provide specific investment advice, must include required disclosures, and must escalate advice-requiring inquiries to licensed representatives. ClickMasters builds these controls into the chatbot logic, not as post-hoc filters.
items.label: FINRA · CFTC

items.title: Healthcare (HIPAA)
items.description: Patient-facing chatbots that access or discuss PHI require HIPAA-compliant infrastructure and a Business Associate Agreement. ClickMasters executes BAA before any PHI access in Chicago healthcare chatbot engagements.
items.label: HIPAA

items.title: Illinois BIPA
items.description: The Illinois Biometric Information Privacy Act has the strictest biometric data protection in the US — for chatbots that use voice biometrics or any biometric authentication, BIPA compliance requires explicit written consent. ClickMasters designs voice-enabled chatbots with BIPA consent mechanisms for Illinois deployments.
items.label: Illinois BIPA

sections.note: Definitive regulatory compliance determinations require qualified legal counsel. ClickMasters provides technical implementation and documentation.
